items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-08-30
items.q: We could have got them, but we was too old. Our men are dying too fast. We were too old to get them, Teddy Rose, Teddy Rose, Teddy Rose, all the organization sold us to get them guns because they disqualified them in the regular hours.

ctx.x: Is that the Springfield 03? Is that it? Yeah. Is that the Springfield 03?

Yeah, all of them. They got about six. I bet they got seven, eight of them guns up there. We could have got them, but we was too old. Our men are dying too fast. We were too old to get them, Teddy Rose, Teddy Rose, Teddy Rose, all the organization sold us to get them guns because they disqualified them in the regular hours. And the guns now they got is not near as good as that gun there. Them guns there, I know what they'll do. I would never kill you 2,300 yards and show you living. I know that myself. They can't…
Well, in those days, how long could they keep somebody? 24 hours.
